Proposed

AfroBot USA

We plan a US season. The four regions are tentative. Dates aren’t final yet.

The first season is an 8-team pilot. Teams are about 8 students plus coaches. Ages stay on Programs. Dallas–Fort Worth, Yaoundé, and Tanzania stay on Competitions.

Register your interest

The plan so far

  1. August 2027

    We plan to start then. Dates aren’t final yet.

  2. Tentative 2027 target regions

    DC and Maryland, Atlanta, Houston, and Dallas–Fort Worth.

  3. April 2028

    We plan a championship in Dallas. This is proposed, and it still needs a partner.

  4. How to sign up

    Parents can register interest. Ages run from Discover through Advance.
